questions.question: In a certain code language, 'UKSH' is written as '8TL21'. How will 'GAIN' be written in that language?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : 

 
• **First and last letters → Position value** according to the English alphabetic series is written diagonally.
 
• Second and third letters → (1) is added to the position value according to the English alphabetic series diagonally.

So,

 
• 'UKSH' is written as '8TL21'

​Hence, "ONSLBK" is the correct answer.

questions.question: If in a coding system DAYCARE is coded as 54 and JOURNEY is coded as 105, then how will FURTHER be coded in the same coding system?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/889ff2be8a048327f450a975a401b2f4241e5f28d86896613386ad4014cb4505.png] 

The logic followed here is:-

(Sum of the place value of the letters in a word) - 3

DAYCARE = 54

(Sum of the place value of letters of the word DAYCARE) - 3

[D(4) + A(1) + Y(25) + C(3) + A(1) + R(18) + E(5)] - 3

= (4 + 1 + 25 + 3 + 1 + 18 + 5) - 3

= 57 - 3

= 54.

And,

(Sum of the place value of letters of the word JOURNEY) - 3

[J(10) + O(15) + U(21) + R(18) + N(14) + E(5) + Y(25)] - 3

= (10 + 15 + 21 + 18 + 14 + 5 + 25) - 3

= 108 - 3

= 105.

Similarly, 

**(Sum of the place value of letters of the word FURTHER) - 3**

**[F(6) + U(21) + R(18) + T(20) + H(8) + E(5) + R(18)] - 3**

**= (6 + 21 + 18 + 20 + 8 + 5 + 18) - 3**

**= 96 - 3**

= **93.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"option 4"**.
